subject: Demo follow-up: deployment route + sandbox endpoint request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightmesh.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo follow-up: deployment route + sandbox endpoint request

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size the right evaluation path (Hosted API pilot vs Dedicated vs Private VPC):

Key points I captured from our call:
- Primary goal: surface-level personalization for search + chat across web and mobile (English-only to start)
- Traffic shape: small baseline (~5-10 req/s) with predictable daily spikes up to ~80 req/s during checkouts; occasional short spikes to ~150 req/s for marketing blasts
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms for snippets/generation (customer experience team cares)
- Data residency: production data will remain in BrightMesh; some logs contain hashed PII — need guidance on retention/controls

Quick qualification asks to pick the pilot mode:
1) Would you be comfortable starting on Hosted API for the 30-day pilot if we provide sandbox endpoints and clear ratecaps, with an agreed fallback to Dedicated if residency/SLA needs demand it?
2) Can you share a short sample traffic profile (CSV or summary) — per-endpoint expected RPS and typical prompt lengths?
3) Any internal compliance items we should route to our security team (SOC 2 evidence, IP allowlist, SSO)?

Next steps from our side:
- I attached a one-page mutual action plan and our network requirements PDF to speed ops onboarding.
- If Hosted pilot looks good, we can provision sandbox endpoints (staging keys + per-endpoint rate limits) within 2 business days once we get the traffic profile.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m call with your infra/security folks if that helps.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), network-requirements.pdf (pdf)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightmesh.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightmesh.io
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: deployment route + sandbox endpoint request

Hi Hannah — thanks for the concise recap and the attachments. Quick answers from our side: 

1) We'd prefer to validate on Hosted first if the pilot can meet our latency/throughput needs and has reasonable controls for log retention. We are wary of pushing PII into logs; can you confirm what is retained by default and the retention window for request/response logs?
2) I've attached a skimmed traffic profile and our SSO/SLA excerpt for context. Expect average prompt sizes of ~150 tokens for search augmentation and ~350 tokens for multi-turn support.
3) If retention or compliance becomes a blocker, we will look at Dedicated or VPC. For now, please treat Dedicated as an escalation path rather than the default.

Security would like a 30-minute call with your trust team this week to review SOC2 artifacts and encryption key handling. Can you propose two slots?

Thanks — copying security@brightmesh.io who will coordinate availability.

—
Sarah Liu
Head of Product, BrightMesh
sarah.liu@brightmesh.io
Attachments: BrightMesh_traffic_profile.csv, BrightMesh_sso_sla.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Demo follow-up: deployment route + sandbox endpoint request

Ben / Aditya — forwarding Sarah's reply and attachments. Highlights: BrightMesh is open to Hosted pilot but needs clarity on log retention, and security wants SOC2 + key handling call. Traffic profile attached shows baseline ~8rps, peaks ~150rps for very short periods; avg token sizes 150/350.

Can you advise quickly on: 
- Recommended sandbox endpoint ratecaps we should propose (per-endpoint and global throttle) for a pilot that won't block their spikes but protects our capacity?
- Default log retention policy for Hosted and a short blurb we can share with security about how request/response data and KV/prefix caches are handled (esp. masking PII and retention windows).
- If we surface a Dedicated fallback in the MAP, what is a conservative lead time to spin up a small Dedicated pool for them?

I'm proposing we offer: staging API keys + two endpoints (chat + snip-search), 100 rps global throttle with burst to 200 for 60s, and a security call this week. Thoughts?

—
Hannah

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 13:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Demo follow-up: deployment route + sandbox endpoint request

Hannah — thanks for the context. Agree brightmesh looks like a Hosted-first pilot. My quick recommendations below (and I attached a small csv with a preferred rate-plan):

Sandbox proposal:
- Provision two staging routes: /v1/chat (multi-turn), /v1/generate (snippets/search).
- Default pilot limits: 120 rps global across routes with route-level soft caps (chat: 60 rps, generate: 80 rps). Allow a short burst policy: +100 rps for 45-60s, cooldown 5 minutes.
- Token ceilings: per-request token limit 2048 for chat, 1024 for generate. Set a soft cost guard on long responses to prevent runaway costs.

Logs & retention (Hosted):
- By default Hosted captures minimal request metadata + debug logs; payloads are stored encrypted and retained 14 days. We can enable shorter retention (7 days) or disable full request retention for the pilot; we also support redaction hooks (masking PII) at the API side prior to logging. I'll send a one-paragraph blurb your security team can share.

Dedicated fallback timeline:
- Small reserved pool (1-2 GPUs) setup and onboarding: ~3 weeks from signed commitment + infra carve-out; expedited paths can get to ~10 business days but require a stronger purchase commitment.

I'm attaching rateplan-proposal.csv with the exact numbers. My call slots for the security sync: Thu 01 Jul 2027 16:00-16:30 PT or Fri 02 Jul 09:00-09:30 PT — either works for me.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: rateplan-proposal.csv

Subject: Proposed pilot plan & next steps (staging endpoints + security sync)

Sarah — thanks for the quick reply and for looping security. Per Ben's suggestions above, proposed next steps so we can get your team started this week: 

1) We will provision staging API keys and two sandbox routes (/v1/chat, /v1/generate) by EOD Friday. Pilot defaults: 120 rps global (chat 60 / generate 80), burst to +100 rps for up to 60s. Token caps: chat 2048 / generate 1024.
2) Security sync: we can do Thu 01 Jul 2027 16:00 PT (Ben on the call) — if that doesn't work for any of your folks, suggest an alternate 30m slot. Agenda: SOC2 artifacts, retention policy, KMS/hsm handling, IP allowlist.
3) Please upload the short traffic CSV to the linked MAP doc and confirm which datasets include hashed PII so we can draft the redaction flow.
4) If retention/encryption requirements can't be met in Hosted, we will scope Dedicated as an escalation path (Ben notes ~3 weeks to provision a small reserved pool).

Links: HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 | MAP: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-MAP

If that looks good, I'll send the staging keys and the security blurb after the call.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.
